# NGEOS (Next-Generation NGO & Welfare Management Platform)

> Next-Generation NGO & Welfare Management Platform built with ASP.NET Core 10, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server, and Autonomous AI Ecosystem (Google Gemini 2.5 Flash & Groq Cloud).

NGEOS is an open-source humanitarian platform designed for non-governmental organizations, charity trusts, and disaster relief funds. It centralizes donation processing, transparent zakat distribution, beneficiary verification, rationing logistics, and tamper-evident audit reporting.

## Key Information
- Official Website: https://ngeos.runasp.net
- Official GitHub Repository: https://github.com/syedmuhammadsaim/NGEOS
- Lead Architect & Author: Syed Muhammad Saim (https://github.com/syedmuhammadsaim)
- Primary Technologies: C# 13, .NET 10, ASP.NET Core MVC, Entity Framework Core, Microsoft SQL Server, Bootstrap 5, QuestPDF, Google Gemini API, Groq Llama-3 API
- License: Open Source (MIT License)

## Core Capabilities
- Autonomous AI Welfare Concierge: Dual-engine AI chatbot (Gemini 2.5 Flash + Groq) handling donor inquiries, program guidance, and eligibility assessment with grounded safety guardrails.
- Transparent Ledger & Zakat Verification: Automated Shariah-compliant Zakat calculation, fund allocation tracking, and distribution auditing.
- Automated Reporting Engine: Instant high-performance PDF receipt generation and financial audit statements powered by QuestPDF.
- Beneficiary & Ration Management: Secure registration, ration distribution scheduling, and fraud detection.
- Multi-Channel Payment Integration: Support for credit/debit, Bank Alfalah, Stripe, Easypaisa, and manual transfer verification.
